title: A producer finds a kick by ear and puts it on a pad

steps.caption: Press the BD pad's sample slot: the library opens on kicks
Choose a genre: the list narrows to its kicks, and counts them
Click a kick: it is selected, and it is the one you are hearing
Press the down arrow: the next kick is the one you are hearing
Press Escape: the slot still names the sound it had before
Select a different kick and press Insert: the slot names it
Reload: the BD pad still holds the kick you inserted
